reasoning.ade_dynamic_error_beta0.5_trim0.8: series_profile.model_landscape.concept_drift=true → dynamic error weighting adapts to changing model performance (Gaillard et al. 2015; Montero-Manso et al. 2020)
reasoning.inverse_rmse_weights_k4_sh0.35: series_profile.model_landscape.rmse_spread_ratio=1.4383 AND combination_recommendation.regularization=high → shrinkage=0.35 + top_k=4 matches recommended_knobs for noisy, unstable environments (Hansen et al. 2011; Genre et al. 2013)
reasoning.trimmed_mean_r0.10: series_profile.model_landscape.rankings_stable=false (kendall_tau=-0.5906) → trimmed mean robust to outlier models (Genre et al. 2013)

excluded_highlights.stl_hierarchical_stacking_p4_sh0.2: series_profile.noise.level=high AND model_landscape.models_redundant=false → STL decomposition may not exploit component differences effectively in high-noise scenarios
